source.basis: Quoted evidence supports the claim; its interpretation still needs current-source checks.

text: The new unit task waits for the refresh operation to stop pending and checks NS_OK, while its fake events endpoint returns an empty value array. It therefore does not invoke event conversion or assert item count, identity, title or dates. A later accepted batching task creates six events and checks count, IDs, titles and a sync token; that is a separate source phase. Neither the original test nor the later one was executed in this study.
title: The initial Graph refresh test covers an empty event response
